visible_text_labels: TDPDM Administration Script: During this test, the machine is going to move very slowly to either straighten or bend your elbow. We will play eight trials. At the start of each trial, there will be a tone. The machine will either move your arm or may not move your arm. Please press the button as soon as you feel your arm move. If you don't feel movement, try to pay attention until we stop the trial. This is the button you'll be using. Please press the button right now to test it.
